title: The Day of the Good Blanket
skyStory: Forty-three percent of the moon lounges in Taurus, still comfortable, still unbothered. Taurus has found the good blanket, the heavy one, and it is not sharing. Saturn tries to borrow a corner. Mars brings snacks as a bribe. The moon finally relents and spreads the blanket over the whole sky. Even the snowbanks below look cosier tonight.

reading: Saturday rolls in heavy and warm, like a cat settling onto your lap. The Tiger wants to do something. The Taurus moon wants to do nothing. Negotiate. Maybe one small adventure in the morning, then the blanket by noon.

This afternoon, someone will offer you something nice, a cup of tea or a compliment or the good chair. Your instinct will be to refuse, politely, and offer it back. The [[Six of Pentacles]] is waving its arms. Accept it. Receive it. Sit in the good chair like it was built for you. It was.
joel.mission: Accept every small kindness offered to you today with a plain thank you and zero protest.
joel.omen: A blanket hung over a balcony railing or a clothesline. It means comfort is coming your way.
joel.stoneWhy: warm red for a cosy day

reading: There is a particular kind of February Saturday that smells like woodsmoke and bread, and today is it. Even if nobody is baking. Even if the stove is electric. The air simply decides to smell that way, and you get to enjoy it.

Find the best blanket in the house and claim it. If anyone asks, you are conducting important Saturn research on comfort. By late afternoon, an old friend or an old memory will drift in, warm and unexpected. Let it stay for a while. The [[Four of Cups]] is offering something good. Take it.
nancy.mission: Claim the coziest seat in your home for at least an hour and defend it with a dignified look.
nancy.omen: Steam rising from a mug in a sunbeam. It means a happy memory is on its way to visit.
nancy.stoneWhy: soft glow for a soft day

together.text: Send each other a photo of your blanket situation at exactly 4 pm. Rate each other's on a scale of one to ten mountains. Tomorrow is a day for friends, so rest up, because the Gemini moon has big plans for both of you.

game.intro: Good blanket day. Saturn has claimed the corner of the couch. Spell us something worth staying under for.
game.prompt: A cozy movie worth watching under the good blanket.
